title: 区间选举中Thiele规则的计算及其推广
summary: 本文解决了在选民区间（VI）域上计算Thiele规则（如比例批准投票PAV）的复杂度问题，证明标准线性规划仍存在最优整数解，并提供了快速算法。研究还扩展到选民-候选人区间（VCI）域和线性一致（LC）域，揭示了LC严格包含VCI的关系，并给出了LC的等价定义。
summary_en: This paper resolves the complexity of computing Thiele rules (e.g., PAV) on the voter interval (VI) domain, showing the standard LP admits an optimal integral solution and providing a fast algorithm. It extends to VCI and linearly consistent (LC) domains, proving LC strictly contains VCI and offering an equivalent definition.
